item: tweak-travel (3.5): an edit changed in the editor diff pane before accepting
branch: __perm_answered{tweaked,oldStr,newStr} REPLACES the live card's .diff with a 3-line-context hunk of the edit that RAN (wholeFileHunk → patchRows, re-folded) and adds the LIM.tweakNote line; replay draws the same line from the item's `tweaked` flag (SessionStore ← EditProposals.tweaked) under the structuredPatch card. Untweaked answers and untweaked replay items draw NO note.
provenance: The permission_request frame is ChatPanel's synthetic shape (fixture 11). __perm_answered's tweaked/oldStr/newStr are OUR OWN Kotlin→JS fields (ChatPanel.respondFromEditor), so the live steps are self-consistency evidence. The __transcript item mirrors what SessionStore serializes for the 2026-08-28 probe session f63143c3 (CLI 2.1.250): the model proposed beta→BETA, the pane accepted 'BETA (tweaked by user)', the CLI applied it and persisted toolUseResult{oldString,newString,originalFile,structuredPatch,userModified:false} while the tool_use kept the ORIGINAL input — the structuredPatch hunk below is that record's, verbatim; `tweaked:true` is the flag EditProposals.tweaked derives from it (pinned in EditProposalsTest). What the CLI does with a whole-file updatedInput was measured in that probe, not here. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-08-28 against the pre-fix webview (whole plugin/src/main/resources/webview/ dir stashed to HEAD 682028e, sandbox restarted, served JS verified BY CONTENT: no 'ev.tweaked' in the page script — note LIM.tweakNote is spliced from Kotlin and is NOT a webview witness): 7 passed, 4 failed, exactly the four DISCRIMINATING asserts — step 1 'diff shows the edit that RAN' (the card kept the proposal's BETA) and 'the note names why' (no .t-note), step 3's two replay-note asserts. Two step-1 asserts pass in BOTH builds and are guards, not discriminators: '- beta' is also in the proposal's diff, and 'BETA\n' is absent from any diff textContent. Steps 2 and 4 (no note without the flag) pass in both builds by design. After stash pop + restart: 15/15.
